workerResult.summary: Crumb Budget — snack-unit spending tracker. Expense log (add/delete/persist in localStorage), snack converter (dollars to snacks with whole+change breakdown, snack picker re-frames the page), and a 7-day weekly bar chart with budget line and tooltips. Glassmorphism design on exactly 3 chromatic colors (candy/toffee/pistachio) + near-black/warm-white, Google Fonts (Fraunces/Outfit/DM Mono), asymmetric candy-counter layout, count-up hero, crunch/chew/blob micro-interactions, reduced-motion support. Build passes; preview serves content with relative asset paths.
